    markdown: "Coralogix Events2Metrics. Converts logs and spans into metrics for long-term monitoring. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/monitoring-and-insights/events2metrics/."

    markdown: "Data source in `<namespace>/<dataset_name>` format. If not set, defaults to the standard logs/spans stream."

    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.

    markdown: "logs-events2metric type. Exactly one of \"spans_query\" or \"logs_query\" must be defined."
logs_query.applications  SetAttribute optional elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "An array that contains log’s application names that we want to be alerted on. Applications can be filtered by prefix, suffix, and contains using the next patterns - filter:startsWith:xxx, filter:endsWith:xxx, filter:contains:xxx"
    validator: setvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator set must contain at least 1 elements

    description: "The search_query that we wanted to be notified on."

    markdown: "An array of severities that we interested in. Can be one of [\"Critical\" \"Debug\" \"Error\" \"Info\" \"Unspecified\" \"Verbose\" \"Warning\"]"
    validator: setvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator set must contain at least 1 elements
    validator: setvalidator.valueStringsAreValidator element value must satisfy all validations: value must be one of: ["Critical" "Debug" "Error" "Info" "Unspecified" "Verbose" "Warning"]
